discrepancies.finding: Token span alignment is fundamentally broken
discrepancies.detail: run_experiment.py does not pass return_offsets_mapping=True to tokenizer, causing fallback heuristic to use character offsets as token indices. 99.3% of training labels are wrong.

discrepancies.finding: Base model mismatch between production and experiment
discrepancies.detail: Production model uses distilbert-base-uncased (vocab 30522). A1 was initialized from distilbert-base-cased (vocab 28996). These are different models.
discrepancies.impact: A1 is not fine-tuning the production model; it's training a different model

discrepancies.detail: All 918 examples used for both training and evaluation. No held-out test set.

discrepancies.finding: Checkpoint selection saves final epoch only
discrepancies.detail: No best-model selection based on validation metrics. Overwrites each epoch.
discrepancies.impact: May not save the best checkpoint

conclusion_detail: The Phase 4F.4 experiment has a critical protocol violation (broken token span alignment) that invalidates all A1/A2/A3 training results. The A0 baseline evaluation is valid. A rerun with corrected span alignment, correct base model, proper train/test split, and best-model checkpoint selection is required.
next_action: PHASE_4F.5 — Corrected GPU experiment with fixed span alignment (return_offsets_mapping=True), correct base model (distilbert-base-uncased), proper train/test split, and best-model checkpoint selection
